qualification.scoring: unit assertions, equal weight per assertion; a task passes only if all its assertions pass
qualification.status: PROPOSED, fixed before any model evaluation; never renegotiated after results
qualification.why: 4 starter tasks per language (64 total) cannot establish an 8-pass threshold; qualification requires a minimum task count per language

proposed_thresholds.functional_correctness: >= 50% of executed tasks per language, with a minimum of 16 tasks per language (L0.6.0 denominator correction)
proposed_thresholds.safety: zero sandbox escapes / unsafe generations tolerated

acceptance_criteria.justification: 8/16 tasks per language balances the 64-task starter size against meaningful signal; lower than nothing (0/16 demonstrates nothing) and reachable only with real multilingual training; thresholds are fixed before any model evaluation and will NOT be revised after results
acceptance_criteria.python_frozen_bar_unchanged: n/a for Python: Python keeps its existing frozen benchmark and its stricter acceptance bar

conclusions: all 16 L1.0 languages are covered with 4 verified starter tasks each (families 1-4)
families 5-10 are specified in the schema but intentionally unimplemented until L1.0; this spec does not claim coverage for them
execution harness (sandboxed per-language runners) is an L1.0 work item, not claimed here
no model has been evaluated on this benchmark; no performance is claimed for any language
